// diagnostic E1134

Jet.MarkerLookupNotMarker

`{name}` is not a marker.

What

`{name}` is not a marker.

Why

`marker(T)` reads the marker `T` written on a reflected item, so `T` names a struct with an `impl Marker` block or a Prelude marker.

Fix

Name a marker struct visible here or a Prelude marker such as `Codable`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MarkerLookupNotMarker: Tests/UI/marker_lookup_refusals.stderr.

 Fix: Name a marker struct visible here or a Prelude marker such as `Codable`
